summary: Interim assay worksheet for the BP16 CYP interaction confirmation on the Belquorin oxazole carboxamide set. The five-isoform inhibition screen is complete and the CYP3A4 concentration-response curves are partly in. Results on two rows are held until the identity of a relabelled vial is confirmed, so no progression call is made yet.

sheets.name: Summary
rows: CYP inhibition panel at 10 µM (1A2, 2C9, 2C19, 2D6, 3A4); CYP3A4 IC50 (midazolam 1'-hydroxylation)
Interim. Partial results; final conclusions pending. No progression recommendation yet.

sheets.name: CYP panel
rows: Human liver microsomes, probe substrates. Negative values are assay noise around zero.
